retrievalLimitations: No PTCG Live behavior, Chinese translation, image or community source is used as rule authority.
The Card-Dex is used as a historical international text example, not a current Standard legality assertion.
Every real card remains unavailable until its complete official text, timing and legality are audited.
implementationLimits: Supports one exact public source and one exact public destination per effect step, including a server-bound destination from an enclosing selection.
The server verifies source counters, current in-play identities and both card-effect protections before moving any counter, then uses the shared KO resolver.

Does not implement multi-source allocation, multi-destination distribution, replacement effects, last-known information, card-specific prevention exceptions, or the historical Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND card.
